summary: Verified coins->XP relabel refactor. Backend regression: all 10 endpoints (wallet/summary, wallet/transfer, learn/complete, garden, stocks, lending, quests, content/complete, teacher/classrooms, parent/children) return healthy responses - no functional regression. Frontend static + browser verification found XP relabel is CORRECT on WalletPage, StorePage, LendingBorrowingPage, StockMarketPage, Dashboard, TopicPage, GiftingPage. BUT found 3 pages with residual/incorrect ₹ symbols that should be XP: MoneyGardenPage (major - garden balance, seeds, transfer dialog Spending option), LessonPage (lesson-complete toast), and QuestsPage (teacher/CoinQuest quest tabs still show ₹).

ui_bugs.issue: Garden Money balance card shows '₹0' instead of 'XP' (line 344). Toast 'Added ₹X to garden' (line 265). Recent Activity rows show '±₹X' (line 365). Seed costs in Market show '₹X' (lines 520, 658, 699, 725). Sell price/proceeds show '₹X' (lines 718, 798, 807). Transfer dialog Spending option shows '💳 Spending (₹X)' instead of XP (line 847). Arithmetic expressions for kids also use ₹ (lines 74, 81, 85). Per review req, ALL of these must be XP except the Piggy Bank source option (line 848).
Success toast on lesson complete still shows '+₹{reward}' instead of '+X XP' (line 49). Header 'Earn X XP' and quiz bonus toasts are correctly XP - only the completion toast is wrong.

Quest reward pills and detail modals show '₹X' hardcoded (lines 186, 207, 582, 658, 759). This is visible in the 'All' tab and will show wrong for Teachers/CoinQuest quest tabs (which credit spending/XP). Toast on completion (line 164) already says 'X XP' - inconsistent with visible pills. Should be conditional: XP for teacher/coinquest/system quests, ₹ only for parent-chore quests that credit my_wallet.

issues: 'Money You Can Spend ₹475' aggregates XP+real money and displays as ₹ - potentially misleading now that spending/investing are XP. Consider showing separately or excluding XP from ₹ total. (Not explicitly in the review-req but worth flagging.)

action_items: MoneyGardenPage.jsx: Convert all ₹ symbols to XP display for garden money balance, seed costs, sell proceeds, transfer dialog Spending option, and math-expression displays. Piggy Bank source option (line 848) stays ₹.
LessonPage.jsx line 49: Change `Lesson completed! +₹${response.data.reward}` to `Lesson completed! +${response.data.reward} XP`.

QuestsPage.jsx: Make reward-display conditional on quest source. Teacher/CoinQuest/system quests -> 'X XP'; parent-chore quests that pay my_wallet -> '₹X'. Affects lines 186, 207, 582, 658, 759 (and success toast on line 207 which uses '+₹').
Optional: reconsider the 'Money You Can Spend' aggregate on WalletPage now that XP and ₹ live in separate mental models.
critical_code_review_comments: The XP vs ₹ display logic is scattered inline (repeated `isXP ? 'XP' : '₹'` patterns) - would benefit from a small helper like `formatWalletAmount(account_type, amount)` to avoid future drift/regressions like the ones found in MoneyGardenPage & QuestsPage.

Backend field names (reward_coins, coins_earned, wallet_source='coinquest') are still coin-flavored; long-term this will confuse future contributors. Document this display-only convention in code comments near the models.
QuestsPage toast on line 164 says 'X XP' but pill on line 186 says '₹X' for the same quest - indicates the initial refactor was incomplete on this file.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (3 pages with display bugs out of ~15 touched)

test_credentials: wallet_demo_child / testpass123 (child, Grade 3); wallet_demo_parent / testpass123 (parent). Login body uses 'identifier' field (not 'username').
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing wallet_demo_child seeded data (195 XP spending, ₹255 my_wallet, ₹25 savings, ₹59 giving).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_xp_relabel_regression.py all pass. After main agent fixes MoneyGardenPage, LessonPage line 49, and QuestsPage conditional display, retest those 3 pages visually. WalletPage, StorePage, LendingBorrowingPage, StockMarketPage, Dashboard, TopicPage, GiftingPage already verified correct. Login uses POST /api/auth/login with body {identifier, password} and returns session_token.
rca of the issue: Root cause: refactor was done via regex + manual pass but MoneyGardenPage.jsx (which has many ₹ literals embedded in arithmetic-teaching strings and market UI) was missed / only partially updated. LessonPage completion-toast was likely missed because it uses `+₹${reward}` template string (regex may have skipped due to `+` prefix). QuestsPage was missed because reward pills use `quest.total_points || quest.reward_amount` field references and are the same UI component for both parent-chore (real money) and teacher/system (XP) quests - refactor needed conditional logic that wasn't applied. Reproduction: login as wallet_demo_child, visit /garden, /quests, complete any lesson - ₹ symbols visible where XP was expected.
